title: Prime-Interval Algebras
summary: Starting from a positive integer $n$ and no a priori information about the primes above it, we construct a polynomial quotient ring that recovers exactly the primes in $(n,2n]$ from a single modular exponentiation. The primes occur simultaneously as the nonzero monomial degrees of the resulting polynomial remainder, and each coefficient independently certifies its corresponding prime through its additive order.
